components.notes: Single slash command; no MCP/LSP/hooks/agents/skills (1.0.1 tree: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, commands/code-review.md, README.md, LICENSE). Approved 2026-05-30 as upstreamVersion 'unknown' because the cache held only 'unknown' and git-hash dirs. Re-analysed 2026-10-31 (CodySwannGT/lisa#4556) when upstream began publishing semver: the 1.0.1 manifest now carries version 1.0.1, and the cache's 1.0.1 dir was read against the 'unknown' snapshot. Component inventory is unchanged; the command's behaviour changed: (1) the review prints to the terminal by default and only posts to the PR with --comment; (2) the 0-100 confidence-scoring pass is replaced by a per-issue validation pass that drops anything not confirmed; (3) an explicit high-signal bar (fails to compile/parse, definitely wrong regardless of input, quotable instruction-file violation) plus a do-not-flag list replaces the old false-positive list; (4) with --comment, findings are posted as inline comments (committable suggestions only when they fully fix the issue) through mcp__github_inline_comment__create_inline_comment; (5) reviewers drop from five to four (two instruction-file compliance, two diff-only bug hunters). The Lisa-native lisa-parity-code-review skill was updated for (1)-(3) and documents (4)/(5) as deliberate divergences; it is now drift-tracked via synced-from.
